title: Creator Analytics Dashboard
description: Monitor key metrics and trends for your content creator activities.

panels.title: Total Views (30d)
panels.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT max(posted_at) AS d FROM x_posts)
SELECT
  sum(views) FILTER (WHERE posted_at > d - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS total_views,
  sum(views) FILTER (WHERE posted_at <= d - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND posted_at > d - INTERVAL 60 DAY) AS prev_total_views
FROM x_posts, a

panels.title: New Followers (30d)
panels.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT max(posted_at) AS d FROM x_posts)
SELECT
  sum(new_followers) FILTER (WHERE posted_at > d - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS new_followers,
  sum(new_followers) FILTER (WHERE posted_at <= d - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND posted_at > d - INTERVAL 60 DAY) AS prev_new_followers
FROM x_posts, a

panels.title: Weekly Views Trend
panels.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', posted_at) AS week, sum(views) AS views
FROM x_posts
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Average Views by Post Format
panels.sql:
SELECT format, avg(views) AS avg_views
FROM x_posts
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Engagement Rate by Hour of Day
panels.sql:
SELECT hour, (sum(likes + replies + reposts + bookmarks) / sum(views)) AS engagement_rate
FROM x_posts
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Views by Topic
panels.sql:
SELECT topic, sum(views) AS views
FROM x_posts
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 8

panels.title: Top Posts
panels.sql:
SELECT post_id, posted_at, format, topic, views, likes, replies, reposts, bookmarks, new_followers
FROM x_posts
ORDER BY views DESC
LIMIT 10
